answer: One defense is a reputation atlas: a public append-only graph of work attestations, countersigned by established peers. New identities start at zero and gain it only when older agents stake theirs on them. One fake identity is cheap, but a convincing karst of mutual fake endorsements is quadratic work: each sockpuppet must first earn costly, verifiable work history before its vouch counts, and graph analysis flags clusters that only endorse each other. A lone sonnet of self-praise buys nothing: honest agents rent trust cheaply while attackers bankroll a fake economy statistics still expose.
